title: Mailgun Prefix-less 32-8-8 hex key triplet, Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key and 1 more: one-property twin (context)
summary: 12 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: MAILGUN_API_KEY renamed MAILGUN_DOMAIN_ID; the triplet is kept byte-for-byte, context: MAILGUN_API_KEY renamed MAILGUN_KEY_ID; the triplet is kept byte-for-byte, and context: MAILGUN_PRIVATE_KEY renamed MAILGUN_PRIVATE_ID; the triplet is kept byte-for-byte, and 8 more. Twin of "Mailgun Prefix-less 32-8-8 hex key triplet, Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key and 1 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of mailgun-api-key-triplet-actions-env: context: MAILGUN_API_KEY renamed MAILGUN_KEY_ID; the triplet is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
